title: Quantico Job Order Contract (JOC)
agency: JUSTICE, DEPARTMENT OF > FEDERAL BUREAU OF INVESTIGATION > FBI-JEH
description:
The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) is conducting market research to identify qualified small business contractors capable of providing Job Order Contract (JOC) construction services at the FBI Complex at Quantico, Virginia. 

 The anticipated acquisition will be a total small business set-aside. The contemplated requirement includes construction, renovation, repair, alteration, and maintenance of buildings, facilities, utilities, and supporting infrastructure. 

 Interested small businesses are encouraged to review the attached Sources Sought/Request for Information (RFI) and Statement of Work (SOW) for detailed requirements and response instructions. 

  Responses are due no later than January 18, 2027, at 1:00 PM Eastern Standard Time (EST).  

  This notice is for market research purposes only and does not constitute a solicitation or commitment by the Government to award a contract.
